Returns this->localPlayerIndex (+0x5D0): this machine's slot (0..5) in the network session player table (+0x764, 6 x 0x2C).
Written by host/join (0x40A6EC, from AddPlayer 0x409360), on msg 7 when DPID matches ours (+0x5D4),
decremented when a lower slot leaves (DPSYS_DELETEPLAYER 0x21, 0x40B5AE), zeroed on close (0x40BCFE).
InitGame passes it to ConstructGame -> Game+0x24 and stores it in 0x662780. Confidence: high.

Registers the network 'exit game' handler: slot 4 of the event table at this+0x48 (12-byte entries {cb, ctx, tag});
writes this+0x78=cb, +0x7C=ctx, +0x80=4. Fired by FUN_004098e0 (dispatch) as cb(ctx, *arg) from the DirectPlay
message handler 0x40B520 with reason 0/1/2, which then sets this+0x8EC=1.
InitGame passes ExitGameCallback 0x461A50 and the new Game*. this = network session 0x674268. Confidence: high.

Returns number of occupied MP player slots (0..6): counts non-zero dwords at this+0x764 + i*0x2C, i=0..5.
this = network session global 0x674268. Result is the Game player count (ConstructGame arg1 -> Game+0x23; SP passes 1).
Pure, no side effects. Confidence: high (count), medium (object kind).

RoadNetwork ctor (0xCC68; name is a hypothesis). Road-junction graph for car AI: 545 x 16 B junction nodes at +8 (second 545x16 array at +0x861c), 50 per-car route slots of 256 u16 junction ids at +0x2218. Debug key 7 prints 'Junc: %d'.

SoundEventQueue: 0x50 x 0x28-byte audio event slots + count at +0xC84, reset every GameTick. Pushed by collision/movement code (0x4102a0, 0x410370, 0x410210), gated on skip_audio; registers as sound client type 6. Name is a hypothesis (impact sound events).
ConstructGame tail (skip_audio == 0): ECX = g_SoundManager, jumps to SoundManager_InitOnce (0x4B2F20). Was named NoSkipAudio.

Returns true if 3D (DirectSound3D/MSS) sound is active: sound-manager object 0x5DCBC8 enabled (byte+0) && +0x1D.
Tail chunk at 0x4166D0; incoming ECX ignored (thunk loads ECX=0x5DCBC8).
Callers write the result back to registry do_3d_sound right after RelatedToAudio(0x410670) requested it,
so an unsupported 3D setting is reset. Confidence: high.

CarManager ctor (108 B). Creates the car sub-singletons (relToCars 0xe0c4, CarPhysicsPool 0xd264, CarsS4 0x8f74, PositionStruct), zeroes per-car-type counters (recycled/unit/mission cars), applies do_free_shopping. Freed in Game_Dtor.

CarModelTable ctor (0x808 B). Zeroes two 256-entry tables indexed by car model id: +0x000 derived per-model data, +0x404 CarInfo*; counters at +0x400/+0x804. Filled after the STY load (FUN_00432aa0, carinfo.cpp).

Dummy-ped manager (char.cpp). Lazily creates PedManager (0x203ac B), sprite pool ptrTo_relSprites and S30; inits relToS24_unk* spawn globals. Object: ushort target dummy count (=0x32), byte[2]=dummy_chars. Name from skip_dummies flag + 'dummy_chars' debug label (medium).

CarDriveOrderPool: 20 x 0x40-byte slots; a car holds its slot at car+0x60. Slot: +0 in-use, +4 ped, +8 mode (1/2/4), +0x14..0x1C target xyz, +0x30 target id. Alloc 0x446200, Free 0x446290. Hypothesis: AI driving order for a ped-driven car.

CollisionManager ctor (collide.cpp). Object 0xC: [0] visit counter, [4] query stamp, [8] 'moving check active' flag. Builds 5 sub-objects into DAT_005e6684..5e6694 (0x8004 and 0x11944 grid/lists, 3 x 0x400 lists). Name: medium confidence.
CraneManager ctor. Array of 10 Crane records (0x15c each) plus live count at +0xD98. Cranes are declared by script (SCRCMD_CRANE_*_DEC) and ticked each frame from GameTick (CraneManager_Update).

CrimeEventQueue (S29, 0xCC; name is a hypothesis): 10 x 0x14 ring buffer (head/tail u16 at +0/+2) of crime events (type 1..4 + position). Pushed from kill/shoot/pickup code via DoSomethingRelatedToPedOcupation, consumed by police reaction code 0x41c600.

CrusherManager ctor. Array of 3 Crusher records (0x30 each) plus count at +0x90. Created by SCRCMD_CRUSHER_BASIC, ticked from GameTick; car contact (object case 0x8f) grabs the car. Crusher logic itself not decompiled.

LayerDrawQueues ctor: 7 per-map-layer draw queues (4-byte list heads over node pools DAT_00672578/DAT_0067257c). Cleared each frame in eachFrame, objects enqueued sorted by Z, each queue flushed per layer in SetupFrameLighting. Name: medium.

DoorManager ctor (door.cpp). 22 door slots (0x38 each), ensures helper singleton DAT_005e9374 (0x2C4) exists; +0x4D0 active door count, +0x4D2 = 0xCD. Updated by DoorManager_Update from GameTick. Semantics: medium.

Loads ~90 debug/cheat byte flags at 0x5EAD50..0x5EADB3 by calling RegGet(name) for each original debug option string (do_blood, skip_trains, ...). Also sets g_replayKeyboardLive and g_replayInputEnabled = 1, g_gxtFileExists = CheckIFGXTexists(), g_showPlayerNames, and advances the 'replaynum' counter. Was HiddenDebugFlags.

Profile-name cheat handler: hashes the player name against CHEATS_CODE. GOURANGA enables cheats; other hashes toggle the g_cheat* / debug flags in 0x5EAD50..0x5EADB3 and play CHEAT_SOUND. E.g. GOREFEST=g_doBlood, EATSOUP=free shopping, ARSESTAR=keep weapons, GODOFGTA=all weapons, RSJABBER=invulnerable.

FrameCounter ctor (8 bytes): [0]=frame number since session start, [1]=random32() sampled each tick by FrameCounter_Advance (called from GameTick). Freed with plain free() in Game_Dtor.
GangRespectContainer (0xCA8): 10 x GangRespect (0x144 each), per-gang respect (+0x11c, clamped to 100) and gang id (+0x13c).

Map/tile renderer state singleton (12036 bytes): visible-tile list and per-layer draw size, used by SetupFrameLighting (0x472110, really the map draw entry) and DrawMapLayer each frame. Freed in Game_Dtor with _free (no dtor). Confidence medium-high.

EmergencyVehiclePool ctor (name is a hypothesis). 10 slots of 0x30 (in-use byte at +0x1E). Allocated by police/ambulance spawn code (FUN_004aa7b0, FUN_004a9ef0, FUN_00473e00), freed in EmergencyVehiclePool_Update.
LightManager (SRelateToNight, 0x1D4CC): free/active list pool of dynamic point lights. Level lights added from FUN_004692b0; expired ones recycled by night() each GameTick when isNight.
FireEngineManager ctor. 2 slots (0x28 each) via FUN_0045b430 + u16 at +0x50. Updated each frame by UpdateFireEngines. Slot semantics not verified.
Free-list pool of 50 x 12-byte list nodes (next at +8, head at +0). Alloc = pop head (0x476DF0), free = ListNodePool_Free. Node users not identified; generic name.
S14 debug leftover (2688 B), used only with the do_mike flag: GameTick calls a bare-ret stub, startGame resets two fields via relInitS14. 5 vec2i + 5 x 0x80 blocks. Name is a low-confidence guess.

AmbulanceManager ctor (medical.cpp). Sets enabled=1, builds the paramedic list and 2 x 0x20 ambulance records (+0xD0), calls reset FUN_00472fe0. Updated each frame by UpdateAmbulances (unless skip_ambulance).

PedPathfinder ctor (0x2FD4): ped on-foot pathfinding, queue of requesting peds (list head +0x3c) and search state/result buffer (+0x40..+0x2fd0, ready flag +0x2fd0). Used from ped walking logic FUN_004380d0 (FUN_0049cf70 = request path).
PoliceManager (SPolice, 0x7B8): 20 x SPoliceSub cop-AI slots, 4 x 124 B per-player tracking records at +0x464, copLevel at +0x654. Ticked by UpdatePolice from GameTick (unless skip_police).

GeneratorManager ctor. 120 Generator records (0x2c each), count +0x14A0, active count +0x14A4, byte +0x14A8. Declared by SCRCMD_GENERATOR_DECSET*; each frame a quarter of them (frame & 3) are ticked and spawn map objects.

Stores a player's name into the session object: wcsncpy(this+0x4B4+idx*0x20, name, 16).
Table = 6 x wchar_t[16] at Menu+0x4B4. InitGame fills it from Game->players[i]+0x83C;
read back by Menu_GetPlayerName (0x45E7A0) for the MP results screen in FrontEnd::Intro (state 7).
Confidence: high on mechanics, medium that Player+0x83C is the player-name field.

Attract-mode demo setup: init keyboard/replay object, replayStatus(+0x38)=3 (PLAYING_EXIT_ON_KEYPRESS),
load data\attract\attrN.rep (N cycles 1..3 via this+0x75345, FUN_0045f600), read replay header without applying
debug flags (FUN_0045f270(0)), load events. Chosen in InitGame instead of input.cpp_PLayReplay when relToPlayReplay
(0x662786) is set; WinMain2 sets it at 0x4D1591 when the frontend returns 4 (assumed: idle-timeout demo). Confidence: high.
KanjiFont ctor (0x28 bytes), created only when locale is Japanese. Sets marker bytes +0x24/+0x25 (0xFE, 0xF7), then loads data\kanji.dat (magic KANJ, version 100) via KanjiFont_LoadKanjiDat.

Network exit-game handler: sprintf '(ExitGameCallback)Called with reason - %d', writes it to the debug
stream 0x5EA6B8 (via 0x461560), then quitGame(game,0,1). Reason codes 0/1/2 not decoded yet. Confidence: high.

Zeroes ~72 cheat/debug byte flags in the Cheats block 0x5EAD51..0x5EADB3 (seuko-mod memory.h GetCheats).
Called only from InitGame 0x461E77 on the multiplayer branch, before new Game. No args, no ECX, plain ret.
Some flags in the range are deliberately left untouched (e.g. log_random 0x5EAD63). Confidence: high.

Returns Menu+0x444 = multiplayer game time limit in minutes (0 = none).
Written only by Menu setter 0x45E6C0 (arg5, from [0x673F4C] via 0x4D1131).
InitGame clamps it to 60 into 0x6626E8; timer 0x462530 counts it down (min 0x6626E8 / sec 0x6626C0 / frames 0x662738)
and ends the game with GXT 'g_over'. Confidence: medium-high.
Map block store singleton (GMP data), looked up by (x,y,z). Created by ConstructGame; loaded in LoadGMP_and_STY_Files; freed in Game_Dtor via MapBlocks_Dtor.
Resets the game RNG seed (random_seed) to 1 via Crt_Srand. Called first in ConstructGame so every session starts deterministic.

Mission script engine ctor (miss2.cpp). Zeroes script/string/base-pointer buffers, allocates S16 missions (2284 B) and S17_mission (0x25c B) if absent, opens test\MISS_LOG.TXT if do_miss_logging. Object ~794 KB.

Reset of the multiplayer Tag-mode state (global 0x665704, multip.cpp): zeroes it-player SaveSlot* (+0),
6 per-player tag counters (+4..+0x1B), frame tick (+0x1C), 6 per-player left flags (+0x20..+0x25).
Called by ctor 0x4820C0 (static init 0x535440) and InitGame 0x461E72 (MP branch).
Evidence: FUN_004821c0/4820d0 ('yourit' label), death -> FUN_004822a0. Confidence: high.

ObjectSpawner ctor (object.cpp, 0x5C B). Creates BareGameObjectManager if null, plus pools DAT_0066577c (0x226c) and DAT_00665780 (0x5a40). +0x10/+0x14 counters per prefab category 2/3, +0x1c list head, +0x58 Position. 'this' of SpawnObject. Name: medium.
ObjectPrefabsContainer ctor (0x8CA8 B): 300 x 0x74 prefab entries from +4, 300 pointers at +0x87F4, length=0, eq99OnInit=99. Looked up by object id via FUN_00488170.

park.cpp object (0x48 B). [0] car ptr, [0x0C] state (3 = active), [0x18..0x37] area rectangle from a map block, [0x3C] timer (=0x1E), [0x3D] flag, [0x3E] counter. Used by script commands and ped enter-car logic. Role (parking/garage target) is LOW confidence.

Pool of 40 slots x 0x30 B + 40 in-use flags at +0x780. Alloc ParticleStatePool40_Alloc, release ParticleState_Release. Used for OBJECT_TYPE_PARTICLE_SYSTEM objects (FUN_00485540) and type-5 objects in FUN_00484e00.
Pool of 20 slots x 0x30 B + 20 in-use flags at +0x3C0. Slot ctor ParticleState_Ctor (id byte +4, serial +6). Companion of the 40-slot pool g_ParticleStatePool40. Name is a hypothesis (medium-low).

Particle manager ctor (8 B, particle.cpp). Zeroes two object pointers [0],[1] and lazily creates the particle pool DAT_00669e70 (0x947c B, ctor 0x48F1E0). [0]/[1] are cached game objects used by the car-explosion particle FUN_00490130 (medium).

PedPatrolRoutePool ctor (0x1D7E): 50 route buffers of 0x96 B (up to 50 xyz byte waypoints, 0-terminated) + 50 in-use flags at +0x1d4c. Allocated by PedSetObjective for PED_OBJECTIVE_PATROL_ON_FOOT; nothing frees slots.

PublicTransportManager ctor. 100 x 0x34 stop/track entries at +0, 10 x 0x58 train/bus actors at +0x1450, one extra 0x58 actor at +0x17C0. Loaded from map by relToTrainsAndBuses (trak0..4); updated by PublicTransportManager_Update (honours skip_trains/skip_buses).
One-shot (unknown_used_with_s6 guard) SoundManager init: clears 5 channel slots, queues sound 1, creates the stream at +0x5508. Hypothesis name.

FloatingScoreManager: floating money popups on kills/rewards. Created only when the exploding_on debug flag is 0. 3 popups x 0x50 with free/active lists. Spawn 0x4b91f0, Update 0x4b9260 (GameTick), Draw 0x4b98b0 (eachFrame).

Owner slot table, 255 x 8 bytes: [+0 ped id][+4 refcount byte]. A ped gets a 1..254 slot (ped+0x267) via OwnerSlotTable_AllocSlot; projectiles/objects keep it at obj+0x26 so damage is credited to the shooter (OwnerSlotTable_GetPedId).

Sprite manager root (sprite.cpp 0xca7-0xcae). Creates PositionsArray_S21, S22, S23 and the 0x1c24-B object at 0x6702bc. Object itself: {field0 = sprites drawn this frame, inc = Position id generator}. Name: medium.

Style (STY file) container singleton: sprite/palette/font bases, sprite index, physical palettes, car info chunk + AllCarsInfo, map object info. Created by ConstructGame and InitFrontend; freed in Game_Dtor via StyleData_Dtor.

TaxiList: list of for-hire taxi cars (4 B = head pointer). Nodes {Car*, next} from a shared 100-node pool (DAT_005e580c, taxi.cpp:0x1d), created here if null. Taxis with a driver are added each frame by relToCar; peds wanting a taxi take the nearest (TaxiList_FindNearestCar).

LocaleSettings ctor. Builds two sub-structs, then reads registry value 'language'; accepts e/f/g/i/s/j (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Japanese), otherwise falls back to 'e'. Also created by InitFrontend.

GBH texture cache (0x15D8 B): 1024 tile slots, 48 sprite slots, 96 x 12-byte user slots, 7 palette-remap sub-caches. Used by GetSpriteTexture/DrawTile/DrawSprite2D. Also created by InitFrontend; freed via TextureCache_Dtor (gbh_FreeTexture).

TileAnimManager. The 2-byte object is a short counter = next tile-anim id (starts at 1). Lazily creates the tile-anim pool g_TileAnimPool (0x671C0C, 0x4BC B: 50 x 0x18 entries + free list; tileanim.cpp:0xDC). Used when map blocks change state (0x44C560, 0x44C610).

Frame timing / FPS profiler (0x54). Counts update and draw frames over 100-frame windows (timeGetTime): update FPS +8, draw FPS +0x14, 5 per-subsystem time slots. Updated in drawAndLimitFrames (FrameTimingStats_EndFrame), shown by the do_show_timing overlay.
Traffic light controller (0x194 B): up to 100 light pointers, ushort count +0x190, phase +0x192 (starts at 1), timer +0x193. Phases 1..8 cycle in UpdateTrafficLights; phase 7 = peds cross.

HUD / on-screen text manager (11000 B): message queue (txtMessage +0xE4), 29 debug text labels (+0x818, showDebugLabel), 17 mission arrows (+0x1F18), displayDebugPedInfo (+0x27B5), text_speed (+0x2AF4). Name is a guess from usage (medium-high).

WeaponManager (weapon.cpp:0x97C). 8 bytes: [+0] list head of cars already hit this shot (dedupe in FUN_004cf380), [+4] short live weapon count. Lazily creates the weapon pool (0x2FDC B, 255 x 0x30 slots) in ptrToWeaponRelStruct.
